a: A small practice kept daily, like asking your AI to help plan the morning before the inbox opens
Black goo on a fresh road
n: The quickest way to get good with AI is a small habit: the same kind of question at the same hour, every day. A few minutes each morning beats one long session a month, because repetition shows you what it does well and where it slips. Pick one daily task this week and hand it a first pass.
